mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A U.S. unemployment rate above 4.5% indicates a weakening labor market that signals potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and the Consumer Price Index exceeds 325, it signals a tightening monetary policy amid persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate sustained consumer demand and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods in the late-cycle expansion regime when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruption, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Nonfarm payrolls above 159,000 thousand indicate a robust labor market that sustains consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 159000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1300 thousand units and retail sales exceed 730,000 million dollars, it indicates robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A Consumer Price Index above 325 signals persistent inflation that may prompt aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 325, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
